_comment: Programmazione italiana. Stesso formato di channels_en.json. bumper: transition style between shows (news, leader, terminal, warp, toon, retro, vhs, noir, curtain, neon).
globalExclude: -year:[2006 TO 2100] AND -title:(2006 OR 2007 OR 2008 OR 2009 OR 2010 OR 2011 OR 2012 OR 2013 OR 2014 OR 2015 OR 2016 OR 2017 OR 2018 OR 2019 OR 2020 OR 2021 OR 2022 OR 2023 OR 2024 OR 2025 OR 2026) AND -title:(erotico OR erotica OR erotic OR porno OR porn OR hard OR sesso OR sex OR sexy OR nuda OR nudo OR nude OR nudity OR hentai OR urotsukidoji OR salieri OR moana OR decamerone OR xxx OR babes OR striptease OR nsfw OR gore OR karaoke OR suicidio OR suicide OR cristiana) AND -subject:(erotico OR erotica OR porno OR sesso OR hentai OR adult OR sexy OR sex OR xxx OR nsfw OR erotic OR porn OR karaoke)

filler.query: title:(carosello) OR subject:(carosello) OR (language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND (title:(spot OR pubblicità OR "sequenza spot" OR "sequenze spot" OR reclame) OR subject:(spot OR pubblicità OR "spot pubblicitari" OR carosello)))

channels.name: TG
channels.title: Telegiornale d'Archivio
channels.query: (title:(telegiornale OR tg1 OR tg2 OR tg3 OR tg4 OR tg5 OR "studio aperto" OR "tg2 dossier") AND (language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) OR subject:(rai OR telegiornale))) OR title:("giornale luce" OR "settimana incom" OR cinegiornale OR "istituto luce") OR subject:("istituto luce" OR cinegiornale)

channels.name: QUARK
channels.title: Scienza e Tecnologia
channels.query: title:(quark OR superquark OR "piero angela") OR (language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND subject:(scienza OR tecnologia OR informatica OR computer OR astronomia OR commodore OR amiga OR videogiochi))

channels.name: SCI-FI
channels.title: Fantascienza
channels.query: language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND (subject:(fantascienza OR "science fiction" OR "star trek" OR "spazio 1999" OR ufo OR fantastico) OR title:(fantascienza OR "spazio 1999" OR "star trek"))

channels.name: CARTONI
channels.title: Cartoni Animati
channels.query: language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND (subject:("cartoni animati" OR cartoni OR animazione OR cartoon OR cartoons OR anime) OR title:(goldrake OR "ken il guerriero" OR lupin OR "holly e benji" OR "cartoni animati" OR "capitan harlock" OR "lady oscar" OR "candy candy"))

channels.name: TV
channels.title: Telefilm e Sceneggiati
channels.query: title:(sceneggiato OR telefilm) OR (language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND subject:(telefilm OR "serie tv" OR sitcom OR "serie televisiva" OR sceneggiato OR varietà OR "rai teche" OR "tv italiana"))

channels.name: VHS
channels.title: Videocassette Anni 80/90
channels.query: language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND (title:(vhs OR registrazione OR "sequenza spot" OR "sequenze spot") OR subject:(vhs OR "anni 80" OR "anni 90" OR "bim bum bam" OR italia1 OR canale5 OR "rete 4"))

channels.name: GIALLO
channels.title: Gialli e Polizieschi
channels.query: language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND subject:(noir OR giallo OR poliziesco OR thriller OR "film noir")

channels.name: CINEMA
channels.title: Grande Cinema
channels.query: language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND (collection:feature_films OR subject:("film completo" OR "cinema italiano" OR "film italiano" OR western OR commedia OR "spaghetti western"))

channels.name: DOC
channels.title: Documentari
channels.query: language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND subject:(documentario OR documentari OR documentary OR storia OR natura)

channels.name: MUSICA
channels.title: Videomusic
channels.query: title:(sanremo OR festivalbar OR videoclip OR discoring OR superclassifica OR "vota la voce" OR "un disco per l'estate" OR "azzurro" OR "italo disco") OR (language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND subject:(videoclip OR "music video" OR sanremo OR festivalbar OR "musica italiana" OR "italo disco" OR "musica leggera" OR "canzone italiana" OR pop OR rock))

channels.name: SPOT
channels.title: Carosello e Pubblicità
channels.query: title:(carosello) OR subject:(carosello) OR (language:(ita OR italian OR italiano) AND (title:(spot OR pubblicità OR "sequenza spot" OR "sequenze spot" OR reclame) OR subject:(spot OR pubblicità OR "spot pubblicitari")))
